stories.title: France sees fifth straight Saturday of nationwide protests
stories.summary: France saw a fifth consecutive Saturday of nationwide demonstrations, with the interior ministry counting about 106,000 marchers, including 24,000 in Paris, over living costs, education funding and a proposed police bill.

stories.title: Tens of thousands march across Portugal over housing costs
stories.summary: Tens of thousands marched in more than 30 Portuguese cities on Saturday in the largest protest yet against soaring housing costs that many say have put renting or buying a home out of reach.

stories.title: Canada and Philippines conclude free-trade talks
stories.summary: Canada and the Philippines concluded negotiations on a free-trade agreement just one year after launching talks, with a signing targeted for 2027 as Ottawa works to diversify its trade beyond the US.

stories.title: Trump, Putin and Xi set for unprecedented trilateral meeting
stories.summary: The White House and the Kremlin confirmed Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping will hold an unprecedented trilateral meeting Thursday on the APEC sidelines in Shenzhen, where Trump plans to raise nuclear-arms reduction.

stories.title: Transportation secretary blames routine upgrade for ground stop
stories.summary: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed a routine copper-wire equipment upgrade for the nationwide FAA ground stop that halted flights Friday, saying investigators are looking at whether incompetence or faulty equipment caused the chaos.

stories.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long outage
stories.summary: Microsoft said its Outlook, Teams and Copilot services were fully restored after a global outage that disrupted users across more than 70 countries, which the company attributed to a network capacity upgrade.

stories.title: Nvidia board approached Arm CEO Rene Haas about top job
stories.summary: Nvidia board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas about succeeding Jensen Huang, with Tim Cook among other names floated as the search for a new chief executive gets underway after Huang stepped down.

stories.title: Asian governments react to Jensen Huang exit
stories.summary: Asian governments are reacting to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang exit, with the leadership upheaval raising questions about chip supply and AI investment across the region.

stories.title: Texans rule out Hunter, Al-Shaair and Montgomery vs. Browns
stories.summary: The Texans ruled out All-Pro defensive end Danielle Hunter, Pro Bowl linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair and running back David Montgomery for Sunday game in Cleveland, a boost for the 5-4 Browns against a shorthanded Houston defense.

stories.title: Browns make three roster moves ahead of Texans game
stories.summary: Cleveland signed tight end Carsen Ryan to the active roster, placed fullback Michael Burton on injured reserve with a calf injury and elevated tight end Zaire Mitchell-Paden ahead of Sunday matchup with Houston.

stories.title: Ohio State beats Northwestern 28-19 to snap skid
stories.summary: Ohio State defeated Northwestern 28-19 at Ohio Stadium to snap a two-game losing streak, improving to 7-3 as the Buckeyes try to steady a rocky 2026 season.

stories.title: Buckeyes host Northwestern needing a win
stories.summary: Ohio State hosted Northwestern at noon at Ohio Stadium with the Buckeyes entering at 6-3 and No. 20 in the College Football Playoff rankings after back-to-back losses to USC and Oregon.

stories.title: Wolff: Antonelli is not yet a Senna, but may be a Senninha
stories.summary: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said Kimi Antonelli is not yet Ayrton Senna but may become a Senninha, praising the rookie early promise while tempering comparisons to the Brazilian legend.

stories.title: Honda struggling to explain Stroll 13th DNF of season
stories.summary: Honda said it is struggling to explain Lance Stroll completing his 13th non-finish of the 2026 season, the latest reliability setback in a difficult campaign for the Japanese power unit supplier.

stories.title: Tarkov eases seasonal quests and battle pass grind
stories.summary: Battlestate Games eased Escape from Tarkov Kord Breach season: many seasonal quests now have simpler objectives and lower start requirements, Black Division operatives spawn more often but hit softer, and battle pass document limits were raised.

stories.title: Second round of Ohio high school football playoffs set
stories.summary: Regional quarterfinal matchups are set for the second round of the Ohio high school football playoffs, with Columbus-area teams learning their next opponents as the road to Canton continues.
